newsitem.title: CHINA: China coconut firm to build plant in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: China coconut firm to build plant in Philippines.

text.p: China's Coconut Palm Group in the southern island province of Hainan has signed a contract with a Philippine company to set up a joint venture canned fruit juice plant in the Philippines, a company official said on Friday.
Investment by the Chinese side would be $50 million, the official said. He declined to identify the Philippine partner.
Planned annual production capacity of the plant was 50,000 tonnes of tinned natural coconut milk and other tropical fruit juice, he said.
"The Philippines is one of the world's biggest coconut producers, and we have the world's leading coconut processing method," he said, "I think our cooperation will be successful."
The group was currently restructuring and preparing to issue shares to employees to raise funds for plant construction, he said.
The group is the largest coconut milk producer in China, with output of 200,000 tonnes last year and an output value of 1.36 billion yuan ($163.9 million), he said.
